content.short: Paxos is a regulated financial institution providing tokenized RWAs including USDP and gold-backed PAXG.
content.description:
Paxos is a leading regulated blockchain infrastructure platform and financial institution, dedicated to bridging the gap between traditional finance and the decentralized economy. The platform specializes in the tokenization, custody, and settlement of high-quality real-world assets (RWAs). Paxos is the official issuer of several prominent digital assets, including USDP (Pax Dollar), a regulated USD-backed stablecoin, and PAXG (Pax Gold), a token where each unit is backed by one fine troy ounce of physical gold stored in professional vaults.

Subject to rigorous regulatory oversight by the New York State Department of Financial Services (NYDFS), Paxos provides institutional-grade security and transparency for both retail and corporate participants. The platform's infrastructure powers the crypto services of major global companies like PayPal and Interactive Brokers, facilitating the adoption of decentralized technology within mainstream finance. Through its commitment to regulatory alignment and professional-grade asset management, Paxos is building the essential framework for a more efficient and secure global financial system.
